source.text: Πᾶς γὰρ ἀρχιερεὺς ἐξ ἀνθρώπων λαμβανόμενος ὑπὲρ ἀνθρώπων καθίσταται τὰ πρὸς τὸν θεόν, ἵνα προσφέρῃ δῶρά τε καὶ θυσίας ὑπὲρ ἁμαρτιῶν, μετριοπαθεῖν δυνάμενος τοῖς ἀγνοοῦσι καὶ πλανωμένοις ἐπεὶ καὶ αὐτὸς περίκειται ἀσθένειαν, καὶ δι’ αὐτὴν ὀφείλει, καθὼς περὶ τοῦ λαοῦ, οὕτως καὶ περὶ αὑτοῦ προσφέρειν περὶ ἁμαρτιῶν.

records.literal_gloss: Every for high priest from men being taken on behalf of men is appointed [in] the [things] toward the God, that he may offer gifts both and sacrifices for sins, \v 2 to deal moderately being able with the [ones] being ignorant and going astray, since also he himself is surrounded [with] weakness, \v 3 and because of it he ought, as for the people, so also for himself to offer for sins.

en.L: For every high priest, being taken from among {{gender:human beings|men}}, is appointed on behalf of {{gender:human beings|men}} [in] the things toward God, so that he may offer both gifts and sacrifices for sins, \v 2 being able to deal moderately with those who are ignorant and going astray, since he himself also is surrounded with weakness; \v 3 and because of it he is obliged, as for the people, so also for himself, to offer for sins.
en.B: Every high priest is taken from among {{gender:human beings|men}} and put in office on behalf of {{gender:human beings|men}} to deal with what concerns God: he brings gifts and sacrifices for sins. \v 2 He is able to be gentle and restrained with those who sin in ignorance and wander from the way, since weakness clings to him as well. \v 3 That weakness is why he must bring offerings for sins on his own account, just as he does for the people.
en.R: Every high priest is chosen from among human beings. He is put in that place to serve people in the things that have to do with God. He offers gifts and sacrifices for sins. \v 2 He can be gentle with people who do wrong because they do not know better, or because they have wandered off the right path. He can be gentle because he is weak too. \v 3 And because he is weak, he has to offer sacrifices for his own sins, just as he does for the sins of the people.

es.L: Porque todo sumo sacerdote, tomado de entre {{gender:los seres humanos|los hombres}}, es constituido a favor de {{gender:los seres humanos|los hombres}} [en] las cosas tocantes a Dios, para que ofrezca tanto dones como sacrificios por [los] pecados, \v 2 pudiendo tratar con mesura a los que ignoran y se extravían, puesto que también él mismo está rodeado de debilidad; \v 3 y a causa de ella está obligado, como por el pueblo, así también por sí mismo, a ofrecer por [los] pecados.
es.B: Todo sumo sacerdote es tomado de entre {{gender:los seres humanos|los hombres}} y puesto en su cargo a favor de {{gender:los seres humanos|los hombres}} para ocuparse de lo que concierne a Dios: presenta dones y sacrificios por los pecados. \v 2 Puede tratar con suavidad y mesura a los que pecan por ignorancia y se desvían del camino, ya que también a él lo envuelve la debilidad. \v 3 Por esa debilidad tiene que presentar ofrendas por sus propios pecados, igual que lo hace por el pueblo.
es.R: Todo sumo sacerdote es escogido de entre los seres humanos. Se le pone en ese lugar para servir a la gente en las cosas que tienen que ver con Dios. Él ofrece dones y sacrificios por los pecados. \v 2 Puede tratar con suavidad a los que hacen lo malo porque no saben más, o porque se han salido del buen camino. Puede tratarlos con suavidad porque él también es débil. \v 3 Y como es débil, tiene que ofrecer sacrificios por sus propios pecados, igual que lo hace por los pecados del pueblo.

fr.L: Car tout grand prêtre, pris d’entre les {{gender:humains|hommes}}, est établi en faveur des {{gender:humains|hommes}} [pour] les choses qui concernent Dieu, afin d’offrir à la fois des dons et des sacrifices pour les péchés, \v 2 étant capable d’user de modération envers ceux qui sont ignorants et qui s’égarent, puisque lui-même aussi est entouré de faiblesse ; \v 3 et à cause d’elle il est tenu, comme pour le peuple, de même aussi pour lui-même, d’offrir pour les péchés.
fr.B: Tout grand prêtre est pris d’entre les {{gender:humains|hommes}} et institué en faveur des {{gender:humains|hommes}} pour s’occuper de ce qui concerne Dieu : il présente des dons et des sacrifices pour les péchés. \v 2 Il est capable d’être doux et mesuré envers ceux qui pèchent par ignorance et s’écartent du chemin, puisque la faiblesse l’enveloppe, lui aussi. \v 3 C’est à cause de cette faiblesse qu’il doit présenter des offrandes pour ses propres péchés, comme il le fait pour le peuple.
fr.R: Tout grand prêtre est choisi parmi les êtres humains. Il est placé là pour servir les gens dans les choses qui concernent Dieu. Il offre des dons et des sacrifices pour les péchés. \v 2 Il peut être doux avec ceux qui font le mal parce qu’ils ignorent ce qui est bien, ou parce qu’ils se sont écartés du bon chemin. Il peut être doux parce qu’il est faible, lui aussi. \v 3 Et parce qu’il est faible, il doit offrir des sacrifices pour ses propres péchés, comme il le fait pour les péchés du peuple.

sw.L: Kwa maana kila kuhani mkuu, akichukuliwa kutoka miongoni mwa wanadamu, huwekwa kwa ajili ya wanadamu [katika] mambo yanayomwelekea Mungu, ili atoe zawadi na pia dhabihu kwa ajili ya dhambi, \v 2 akiweza kuwachukulia kwa kiasi wale wasiojua na wanaopotea, kwa kuwa yeye mwenyewe pia amezungukwa na udhaifu; \v 3 na kwa sababu ya [udhaifu] huo analazimika, kama kwa ajili ya watu, vivyo hivyo pia kwa ajili yake mwenyewe, kutoa [sadaka] kwa ajili ya dhambi.
sw.B: Kila kuhani mkuu huchukuliwa kutoka miongoni mwa wanadamu na kuwekwa kazini kwa ajili ya wanadamu, ili ashughulikie mambo yanayohusiana na Mungu: hutoa zawadi na dhabihu kwa ajili ya dhambi. \v 2 Anaweza kuwa mpole na mwenye kiasi kwa wale wanaotenda dhambi bila kujua na kupotea njia, kwa kuwa udhaifu unamng'ang'ania yeye pia. \v 3 Udhaifu huo ndio sababu inampasa kutoa sadaka kwa ajili ya dhambi zake mwenyewe, kama anavyofanya kwa ajili ya watu.
sw.R: Kila kuhani mkuu huchaguliwa kutoka miongoni mwa wanadamu. Huwekwa katika nafasi hiyo ili awatumikie watu katika mambo yanayomhusu Mungu. Yeye hutoa zawadi na dhabihu kwa ajili ya dhambi. \v 2 Anaweza kuwa mpole kwa watu wanaokosea kwa sababu hawajui zaidi, au kwa sababu wamepotea njia iliyo sawa. Anaweza kuwa mpole kwa sababu yeye pia ni dhaifu. \v 3 Na kwa kuwa ni dhaifu, inampasa kutoa dhabihu kwa ajili ya dhambi zake mwenyewe, kama anavyofanya kwa ajili ya dhambi za watu.

vi.L: Vì mọi thầy tế lễ thượng phẩm, được chọn từ giữa loài người, đều được lập vì loài người [trong] những việc thuộc về Đức Chúa Trời, để dâng cả lễ vật lẫn sinh tế vì tội lỗi, \v 2 có thể đối xử mềm mại với những người ngu muội và lầm lạc, vì chính ông cũng bị sự yếu đuối bao vây; \v 3 và vì cớ đó ông phải dâng [của lễ] vì tội lỗi, cho dân thể nào thì cho chính mình cũng thể ấy.
vi.B: Mọi thầy tế lễ thượng phẩm đều được chọn từ giữa loài người và được lập lên vì loài người để lo những việc liên quan đến Đức Chúa Trời: ông dâng lễ vật và sinh tế vì tội lỗi. \v 2 Ông có thể đối xử mềm mại và chừng mực với những người phạm tội vì không biết và lạc khỏi đường ngay, vì chính ông cũng mang sự yếu đuối. \v 3 Chính vì sự yếu đuối ấy mà ông phải dâng của lễ vì tội lỗi của mình, cũng như ông dâng cho dân.
vi.R: Mọi thầy tế lễ thượng phẩm đều được chọn từ giữa loài người. Ông được đặt vào chức vụ ấy để phục vụ người ta trong những việc liên quan đến Đức Chúa Trời. Ông dâng lễ vật và sinh tế vì tội lỗi. \v 2 Ông có thể đối xử nhẹ nhàng với những người làm sai vì họ không biết, hoặc vì họ đã đi lạc khỏi đường ngay. Ông có thể nhẹ nhàng như vậy vì chính ông cũng yếu đuối. \v 3 Và vì ông yếu đuối, ông phải dâng sinh tế vì tội lỗi của chính mình, cũng như ông dâng vì tội lỗi của dân.

ko.L: 사람들 가운데서 뽑힌 모든 대제사장은 사람들을 위하여 하나님께 관한 일들에 세움을 받습니다. 이는 그가 죄를 위하여 예물과 제물을 드리게 하려는 것입니다. \v 2 그는 자기 자신도 연약함에 둘러싸여 있으므로, 알지 못하는 사람들과 길을 잃은 사람들을 너그럽게 대할 수 있습니다. \v 3 그리고 그 [연약함] 때문에 그는 백성을 위하여 [하는 것]과 같이 자기 자신을 위하여서도 죄를 위하여 [제물을] 드려야 합니다.
ko.B: 모든 대제사장은 사람들 가운데서 뽑혀, 하나님께 관한 일을 사람들을 대신하여 맡도록 세워집니다. 그는 죄를 위하여 예물과 제물을 드립니다. \v 2 그는 모르고 죄를 짓는 사람들과 길에서 벗어난 사람들을 온유하고 절제 있게 대할 수 있습니다. 그 자신도 연약함에 싸여 있기 때문입니다. \v 3 바로 그 연약함 때문에 그는 백성의 죄를 위하여 제물을 드리듯이 자기 죄를 위하여서도 제물을 드려야 합니다.
ko.R: 모든 대제사장은 사람들 가운데서 뽑힙니다. 그는 하나님과 관계된 일에서 사람들을 섬기도록 그 자리에 세워집니다. 그는 죄를 위하여 예물과 제물을 바칩니다. \v 2 그는 잘 몰라서 잘못을 저지르거나 바른길에서 벗어난 사람들을 너그럽게 대할 수 있습니다. 그 자신도 약하기 때문입니다. \v 3 그리고 그는 약하기 때문에, 백성의 죄를 위하여 제물을 바치는 것처럼 자기 죄를 위하여서도 제물을 바쳐야 합니다.

pt.L: Pois todo sumo sacerdote, tomado dentre os {{gender:seres humanos|homens}}, é constituído em favor dos {{gender:seres humanos|homens}} [nas] coisas relativas a Deus, para que ofereça tanto dons quanto sacrifícios pelos pecados, \v 2 sendo capaz de tratar com moderação os que são ignorantes e se desviam, já que ele mesmo também está cercado de fraqueza; \v 3 e por causa dela ele é obrigado a fazer ofertas pelos pecados, assim como pelo povo, também por si mesmo.
pt.B: Todo sumo sacerdote é escolhido dentre os {{gender:seres humanos|homens}} e constituído em favor dos {{gender:seres humanos|homens}} para cuidar do que diz respeito a Deus: ele apresenta dons e sacrifícios pelos pecados. \v 2 Ele é capaz de ser brando e comedido com os que pecam por ignorância e se desviam do caminho, pois a fraqueza também se agarra a ele. \v 3 É por causa dessa fraqueza que ele precisa apresentar ofertas pelos próprios pecados, assim como faz pelos do povo.
pt.R: Todo sumo sacerdote é escolhido entre os seres humanos. Ele é colocado nesse lugar para servir as pessoas nas coisas que têm a ver com Deus. Ele oferece dons e sacrifícios pelos pecados. \v 2 Ele consegue ser paciente com as pessoas que fazem o que é errado porque não sabem o que é certo, ou porque se desviaram do caminho certo. Ele consegue ser paciente porque ele também é fraco. \v 3 E, por ser fraco, ele tem de oferecer sacrifícios pelos próprios pecados, assim como faz pelos pecados do povo.

am.L: ከሰዎች መካከል የተወሰደ ሊቀ ካህናት ሁሉ በእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ባሉት ነገሮች ስለ ሰዎች ይሾማልና፤ ይኸውም ስለ ኃጢአቶች መባንም መሥዋዕትንም ያቀርብ ዘንድ ነው፤ \v 2 እርሱ ራሱ ደግሞ በድካም የተከበበ ስለ ሆነ፣ ለማያውቁትና ለሚስቱት በልክ ሊራራላቸው ይችላል፤ \v 3 ስለዚህም [ድካም] ስለ ሕዝቡ እንደሚያቀርብ፣ እንዲሁ ስለ ራሱም ስለ ኃጢአቶች ሊያቀርብ ግድ አለበት።
am.B: ሊቀ ካህናት ሁሉ ከሰዎች መካከል ተመርጦ በእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ስላለው ነገር ስለ ሰዎች ይሾማል፤ ስለ ኃጢአቶችም መባንና መሥዋዕትን ያቀርባል። \v 2 እርሱ ራሱ ደግሞ በድካም የተያዘ ስለ ሆነ፣ ባለማወቅ ኃጢአት ለሚሠሩትና ከመንገድ ለሚስቱት በገርነትና በልክ ሊያዝንላቸው ይችላል። \v 3 ስለዚያ ድካሙም፣ ስለ ሕዝቡ እንደሚያደርገው ሁሉ፣ ስለ ራሱም ለኃጢአት መሥዋዕት ማቅረብ ይገባዋል።
am.R: ሊቀ ካህናት ሁሉ ከሰዎች መካከል ይመረጣል። እግዚአብሔርን በሚመለከቱ ነገሮች ሰዎችን እንዲያገለግል በዚያ ስፍራ ይሾማል። ስለ ኃጢአት መባንና መሥዋዕትን ያቀርባል። \v 2 የተሻለውን ባለማወቅ ስሕተት ለሚሠሩ ወይም ከትክክለኛው መንገድ ለሳቱ ሰዎች ገር ሊሆንላቸው ይችላል። ገር ሊሆን የሚችለው እርሱም ደካማ ስለ ሆነ ነው። \v 3 ደካማ ስለ ሆነም፣ ስለ ሕዝቡ ኃጢአት እንደሚያቀርብ ሁሉ ስለ ራሱም ኃጢአት መሥዋዕት ማቅረብ አለበት።

hi.L: क्योंकि हर एक महायाजक मनुष्यों में से लिया जाकर मनुष्यों के लिए परमेश्वर से संबंधित बातों में नियुक्त किया जाता है, ताकि वह पापों के लिए भेंटें और बलिदान दोनों चढ़ाए, \v 2 और वह अनजानों और भटके हुओं के साथ नरमी से पेश आ सकता है, क्योंकि वह आप भी निर्बलता से घिरा है; \v 3 और इसी कारण उसे चाहिए कि जैसे लोगों के लिए, वैसे ही अपने लिए भी पापों के लिए चढ़ावा चढ़ाए।
hi.B: हर महायाजक मनुष्यों में से चुना जाता है और मनुष्यों की ओर से परमेश्वर से जुड़ी बातों के लिए नियुक्त किया जाता है: वह पापों के लिए भेंटें और बलिदान चढ़ाता है। \v 2 वह उन लोगों के साथ नरमी और संयम से पेश आ सकता है जो अनजाने में पाप करते हैं और मार्ग से भटक जाते हैं, क्योंकि निर्बलता उससे भी लिपटी रहती है। \v 3 इसी निर्बलता के कारण उसे अपने पापों के लिए भी चढ़ावे चढ़ाने पड़ते हैं, जैसे वह लोगों के लिए चढ़ाता है।
hi.R: हर महायाजक मनुष्यों में से चुना जाता है। उसे इसलिए यह पद दिया जाता है कि वह परमेश्वर से जुड़ी बातों में लोगों की सेवा करे। वह पापों के लिए भेंटें और बलिदान चढ़ाता है। \v 2 वह उन लोगों के साथ नरमी से पेश आ सकता है जो इसलिए ग़लत करते हैं कि वे बेहतर नहीं जानते, या जो सही रास्ते से भटक गए हैं। वह नरमी से पेश आ सकता है, क्योंकि वह भी कमज़ोर है। \v 3 और क्योंकि वह कमज़ोर है, उसे अपने पापों के लिए भी बलिदान चढ़ाने पड़ते हैं, जैसे वह लोगों के पापों के लिए चढ़ाता है।

ru.L: Ведь всякий первосвященник, взятый из людей, ради людей поставляется на [служение] Богу, чтобы приносить дары и жертвы за грехи, \v 2 будучи способен умеренно обходиться с невежественными и заблуждающимися, поскольку и сам облечён немощью; \v 3 и из-за неё он должен, как за народ, так и за себя самого, приносить [жертвы] за грехи.
ru.B: Каждый первосвященник берётся из людей и ставится ради людей на служение в том, что относится к Богу: он приносит дары и жертвы за грехи. \v 2 Он может быть мягким и сдержанным с теми, кто грешит по незнанию и сбивается с пути, ведь и его самого окружает немощь. \v 3 Из-за этой немощи он должен приносить жертвы за грехи и за самого себя, так же как за народ.
ru.R: Каждого первосвященника выбирают из людей. Его ставят служить людям в том, что касается Бога. Он приносит дары и жертвы за грехи. \v 2 Он может быть мягким с людьми, которые поступают плохо, потому что не знают, как правильно, или потому что сбились с пути. Он может быть мягким, потому что и сам слаб. \v 3 И поскольку он слаб, он должен приносить жертвы за свои грехи, так же как за грехи народа.

uk.L: Бо кожен первосвященик, узятий з-поміж людей, настановляється заради людей у тому, що стосується Бога, щоб приносити і дари, і жертви за гріхи, \v 2 будучи здатним помірковано ставитися до тих, хто не знає і блукає, оскільки й сам він оточений неміччю; \v 3 і через неї він мусить, як за народ, так само і за себе, приносити [жертви] за гріхи.
uk.B: Кожного первосвященика беруть з-поміж людей і настановляють служити людям у тому, що стосується Бога: він приносить дари й жертви за гріхи. \v 2 Він може бути лагідним і стриманим з тими, хто грішить через незнання і збивається з дороги, бо й сам він обтяжений слабкістю. \v 3 Саме через цю слабкість він мусить приносити жертви за гріхи і за себе, так само як за народ.
uk.R: Кожного первосвященика вибирають з-поміж людей. Його ставлять на це місце, щоб він служив людям у тому, що стосується Бога. Він приносить дари й жертви за гріхи. \v 2 Він може бути лагідним з людьми, які роблять зло, бо не знають кращого, або тому, що збилися з правильної дороги. Він може бути лагідним, бо й сам слабкий. \v 3 І через те, що він слабкий, він мусить приносити жертви і за свої гріхи, так само як за гріхи народу.

ja.L: というのは、大祭司はみな、人々の中から選ばれ、人々のために神に関わる事柄について任命されます。それは、罪のために供え物といけにえとをささげるためです。\v 2 彼は、自分自身も弱さを身にまとっているので、無知な人々や迷っている人々を、穏やかに思いやることができます。\v 3 また、その[弱さ]のゆえに、民のためと同じように、自分自身のためにも、罪のために[いけにえを]ささげなければなりません。
ja.B: 大祭司はみな、人々の中から選ばれ、神に関わる事柄について人々のために任命されます。大祭司は、罪のために供え物といけにえをささげるのです。\v 2 大祭司自身も弱さを抱えているので、知らずに罪を犯す人々や、道から迷い出た人々を、行き過ぎずに優しく扱うことができます。\v 3 その弱さのために、大祭司は民のために罪のささげ物をするのと同じように、自分のためにもささげなければなりません。
ja.R: 大祭司はみな、人々の中から選ばれます。大祭司は、神に関わることで人々に仕えるために、その務めに就きます。大祭司は、罪のために、神への贈り物やいけにえをささげます。\v 2 大祭司は、よく分からずに悪いことをしてしまう人や、正しい道から外れてしまった人に、優しく接することができます。自分も弱い人間だからです。\v 3 そして、自分も弱いので、民の罪のためにいけにえをささげるのと同じように、自分の罪のためにもいけにえをささげなければなりません。

decisions.choice: the high priest of Israel, whose task was to offer sacrifices on the people's behalf
decisions.reason: The author describes the high priesthood set up in the law (Exodus 28-29; Leviticus 8-9; Leviticus 16), and uses it to explain Jesus as high priest (4:14-16). "Gifts and sacrifices" covers the offerings in general; 8:3 uses the same pair. The point is that a high priest is himself human and acts for human beings.

decisions.choice: deal moderately: keep one's feelings in measure, neither harsh nor indulgent
decisions.reason: μετριοπαθεῖν means to hold one's feelings within bounds. With wrongdoers it means not flaring up in anger and not excusing the wrong either. It is a different word from the one in 4:15, where Jesus is able to "sympathize" with our weaknesses.

decisions.choice: the ignorant and wandering: people who sin without meaning to defy God
decisions.reason: The law provided sacrifices for sins done in ignorance or by straying (Leviticus 4:2, 13, 22, 27; Numbers 15:22-29), but not for sin done "with a high hand", in open defiance (Numbers 15:30-31). The author has this distinction in view; it returns in 10:26.

decisions.choice: the high priest's offering for his own sins: Leviticus 9:7; 16:6, 11
decisions.reason: On the Day of Atonement the high priest first offered a bull for his own sin and his household's, and then the offering for the people (Leviticus 16:6, 11, 15; compare 9:7). Hebrews 7:27 comes back to this: Jesus had no need to do so.

decisions.choice: {{gender:human beings|men}}
decisions.reason: The point is that the high priest shares the nature of those he serves, human beings, men and women alike, so the gender setting applies; "men" is the traditional alternative. Readable says "human beings" and "people", which need no setting.

decisions.choice: weakness clings to him
decisions.reason: περίκειται means to have something lying around one, like a garment or a chain (Acts 28:20 uses it of Paul's chain). "Clings to him" keeps the picture of weakness he cannot take off.

decisions.choice: tratar con mesura (L), tratar con suavidad y mesura (B), tratar con suavidad (R)
decisions.reason: The meaning decision describes feelings kept in measure, neither harsh nor indulgent, and sets this word apart from the "sympathize" of 4:15. "Compadecerse" is the natural Spanish for 4:15 and would blur the two; "mesura" names the restraint and "suavidad" the gentleness.

decisions.choice: wanadamu, no gender setting (for the chapter)
decisions.reason: "Wanadamu" already means human beings of both sexes, and the only traditional alternative, "wanaume", means males and would change the meaning. So the English gender span has no Swahili counterpart here or in this chapter.

decisions.choice: kuwachukulia kwa kiasi (L), mpole na mwenye kiasi (B), mpole (R)
decisions.reason: The meaning decision describes feelings kept in measure, neither harsh nor indulgent. "Kwa kiasi" (in moderation) keeps that at Literal; Balanced pairs it with gentleness as the English "gentle and restrained" does; Readable keeps only "mpole", as the English Readable keeps "gentle". "Kuwahurumia" (pity) would say more than the Greek.

decisions.choice: user de modération (L), être doux et mesuré (B), être doux (R)
decisions.reason: The meaning decision describes feelings kept in measure, neither harsh nor indulgent. "Compatir" belongs to the "sympathize" of 4:15 and would blur the two words; "être indulgent" leans toward the laxity the word excludes. "Modération" names the restraint, "doux" the gentleness.

decisions.choice: "lễ vật và sinh tế" for gifts and sacrifices (also 8:3; 9:9); "dâng" for offer; "của lễ" for an offering
decisions.reason: Gifts are what is brought to God, and sacrifices are animals killed (m1). "Lễ vật" is the word of the Vietnamese Matthew (23:18-20) for a gift laid on the altar, "sinh tế" the word of the Vietnamese Mark (12:33) and 1 Peter (2:5) for a sacrifice, and "của lễ" the general word for an offering in the Vietnamese Romans (12:1; 3:25). These are kept apart through the letter.

decisions.choice: "loài người", with no gender span; "ông" for the high priest
decisions.reason: "Loài người" already includes men and women, so the English setting has nothing to change, as in the Vietnamese Romans (1:18). Israel's high priests were men, and "ông" is the respectful pronoun for one.

decisions.choice: "예물" for gifts and "제물" for sacrifices; "드리다" (L, B), "바치다" (R) for offering, through the letter; "사람" with no gender span
decisions.reason: "제물" is the established Korean word for a sacrifice (the Korean Romans 3:25 and 1 John 2:2), and "예물" for a gift brought to the altar (the Korean Matthew 5:23), so the pair "gifts and sacrifices" (5:1; 8:3; 9:9) stays two words. Korean "사람" already includes men and women.

decisions.choice: መባ (gift, offering) and መሥዋዕት (sacrifice), through Hebrews
decisions.reason: መሥዋዕት is the word for a sacrifice offered to God and is kept for it at every level; the gifts brought to God are መባ, the word for an offering, since ስጦታ is a present between people.

decisions.choice: ሰዎች (human beings), no gender span
alternatives: a gender span as in the English
decisions.reason: Amharic ሰዎች already means people, women and men, so there is nothing for the gender setting to change.

decisions.choice: No deity_pronoun spans
decisions.reason: The Ethiopic script has no capital letters, so the English deity_pronoun setting has nothing to change in Amharic in this chapter.

decisions.choice: "मनुष्यों" with no gender span
decisions.reason: The English offers "human beings" or "men". "मनुष्य" already means human beings, women and men, so Hindi needs no setting here.

decisions.choice: "भेंटें और बलिदान"
decisions.reason: Gifts and sacrifices, the high priest's offerings (meaning decision m1); "भेंट" and "बलिदान" are kept apart through the book (8:3; 9:9). The ordinary high priest takes plain forms.

decisions.choice: "людей" without a gender span
decisions.reason: The English has {{gender:human beings|men}}; Russian "люди" already means human beings, men and women, so the style guide puts no span on it.

decisions.choice: "людей" with no gender span
decisions.reason: The English needs "{{gender:human beings|men}}"; Ukrainian "люди" already means human beings of either sex, so there is no second wording.

decisions.choice: No gender span: "人々" for anthropoi
decisions.reason: The English spans human beings / men; Japanese "人々" already means people of either sex. The high priest himself is spoken of as a man ("彼", "大祭司"), as in the Law.

decisions.choice: "穏やかに思いやる" (L), "行き過ぎずに優しく扱う" (B), "優しく接する" (R) for metriopathein
decisions.reason: The meaning decision: keeping one's feelings in measure, neither harsh nor indulgent; Balanced keeps both sides.

source.text: καὶ οὐχ ἑαυτῷ τις λαμβάνει τὴν τιμήν, ἀλλὰ καλούμενος ὑπὸ τοῦ θεοῦ, καθώσπερ καὶ Ἀαρών.

records.literal_gloss: And not to himself anyone takes the honor, but being called by the God, just as also Aaron.

en.L: And no one takes the honor for himself, but [he receives it] being called by God, just as Aaron also [was].
en.B: Nobody seizes this honor for himself; it belongs to the one God calls, as God called Aaron.
en.R: No one can give this honor to himself. God has to call him to it, as God called Aaron.

es.L: Y nadie toma el honor para sí mismo, sino [que lo recibe] siendo llamado por Dios, así como también Aarón [lo fue].
es.B: Nadie se apodera de este honor por su cuenta; le corresponde a aquel a quien Dios llama, como Dios llamó a Aarón.
es.R: Nadie puede darse este honor a sí mismo. Dios tiene que llamarlo para eso, como llamó a Aarón.

fr.L: Et personne ne prend l’honneur pour lui-même, mais [il le reçoit] étant appelé par Dieu, comme Aaron aussi [l’a été].
fr.B: Nul ne s’empare de cet honneur ; il revient à celui que Dieu appelle, comme Dieu a appelé Aaron.
fr.R: Personne ne peut se donner cet honneur à lui-même. C’est Dieu qui doit l’appeler, comme Dieu a appelé Aaron.

sw.L: Na hakuna mtu anayeichukua heshima hiyo kwa ajili yake mwenyewe, bali [huipata] akiitwa na Mungu, kama vile Haruni pia [alivyoitwa].
sw.B: Hakuna anayeinyakua heshima hii kwa nafsi yake; ni ya yule ambaye Mungu humwita, kama Mungu alivyomwita Haruni.
sw.R: Hakuna mtu anayeweza kujipa heshima hii. Ni lazima Mungu amwite kwa kazi hiyo, kama Mungu alivyomwita Haruni.

vi.L: Và không ai tự nhận lấy vinh dự ấy cho mình, nhưng [phải] được Đức Chúa Trời kêu gọi, như A-rôn [đã được] vậy.
vi.B: Không ai tự giành lấy vinh dự này cho mình; vinh dự ấy thuộc về người được Đức Chúa Trời kêu gọi, như Đức Chúa Trời đã kêu gọi A-rôn.
vi.R: Không ai có thể tự ban cho mình vinh dự này. Đức Chúa Trời phải kêu gọi người ấy, như Đức Chúa Trời đã kêu gọi A-rôn.

ko.L: 그리고 아무도 이 존귀를 스스로 취하지 않고, 아론과 같이 하나님께 부르심을 받아서 [받습니다].
ko.B: 이 존귀한 직분은 아무도 스스로 차지하지 못합니다. 아론이 그러했듯이, 하나님께서 부르시는 사람이 그것을 받습니다.
ko.R: 아무도 이 존귀한 자리를 스스로 차지할 수 없습니다. 하나님께서 아론을 부르셨듯이, 하나님께서 그 사람을 부르셔야 합니다.

pt.L: E ninguém toma para si mesmo a honra, mas [a recebe] sendo chamado por Deus, assim como também Arão.
pt.B: Ninguém se apodera dessa honra por conta própria; ela pertence àquele a quem Deus chama, como Deus chamou Arão.
pt.R: Ninguém pode dar essa honra a si mesmo. Deus precisa chamar a pessoa para ela, como Deus chamou Arão.

am.L: ማንም ይህን ማዕረግ ለራሱ አይወስድም፤ ነገር ግን አሮን ደግሞ እንደ ተጠራ በእግዚአብሔር ተጠርቶ [ይቀበለዋል]።
am.B: ማንም ይህን ማዕረግ ለራሱ አይነጥቅም፤ ማዕረጉ፣ እግዚአብሔር አሮንን እንደ ጠራው፣ እግዚአብሔር ለሚጠራው ነው።
am.R: ማንም ይህን ማዕረግ ለራሱ ሊሰጥ አይችልም። እግዚአብሔር አሮንን እንደ ጠራው፣ እግዚአብሔር ራሱ ሊጠራው ይገባል።

hi.L: और कोई यह आदर अपने आप नहीं लेता, पर परमेश्वर के द्वारा बुलाया जाकर [पाता है], जैसे हारून भी।
hi.B: कोई भी यह आदर अपने लिए छीन नहीं लेता; यह उसी को मिलता है जिसे परमेश्वर बुलाते हैं, जैसे परमेश्वर ने हारून को बुलाया था।
hi.R: कोई भी यह आदर अपने आप को नहीं दे सकता। परमेश्वर ही उसे इसके लिए बुलाते हैं, जैसे परमेश्वर ने हारून को बुलाया था।

ru.L: И никто сам себе не берёт этой чести, но [получает её] призываемый Богом, как и Аарон.
ru.B: Никто не присваивает себе эту честь; она принадлежит тому, кого призывает Бог, как Бог призвал Аарона.
ru.R: Никто не может сам дать себе эту честь. Бог должен призвать человека к ней, как Бог призвал Аарона.

uk.L: І ніхто не бере цієї честі сам собі, а [отримує її], покликаний Богом, як і Аарон.
uk.B: Ніхто не присвоює собі цієї честі: вона належить тому, кого кличе Бог, як Бог покликав Аарона.
uk.R: Ніхто не може сам дати собі цю честь. Бог мусить покликати людину до неї, як Бог покликав Аарона.

ja.L: また、だれも自分でこの誉れを受けるのではなく、アロンもそうであったように、神によって召されて[受けるのです]。
ja.B: だれも、この誉れを自分で手に入れることはできません。それは、アロンがそうであったように、神に召された者が受けるものです。
ja.R: だれも、この誉れを自分で自分に与えることはできません。神が、アロンを召されたように、その人を召してくださらなければならないのです。

decisions.choice: the honor: the high priestly office itself
decisions.reason: τιμήν is the honor of holding the office. The next verse picks up the thought with the verb "glorify": Christ did not give himself this honor either.

decisions.choice: Aaron was appointed by God, and those who claimed the priesthood for themselves were judged
decisions.reason: God chose Aaron and his sons (Exodus 28:1). When Korah and his followers claimed the priesthood, they were judged, and Aaron's staff that budded showed God's choice (Numbers 16-17). King Uzziah was struck with skin disease when he burned incense in the temple (2 Chronicles 26:16-21).

decisions.choice: it belongs to the one God calls, as God called Aaron
alternatives: he receives it when God calls him
decisions.reason: The Greek leaves the verb of the second half unstated ("but being called by God"). Balanced and Readable supply it and repeat "God" so the comparison with Aaron is clear.

decisions.choice: "vinh dự" for the honor of the office; "A-rôn"
decisions.reason: The honor is the high priestly office itself (m1); "vinh dự" is an honor conferred. "A-rôn" is the Protestant form of Aaron's name.

decisions.choice: ማዕረግ (rank, office of honour)
decisions.reason: The honour here is the high priestly office itself (meaning decision m1); ማዕረግ names an honoured rank, and keeps ክብር free for the glory Christ did not take for himself in 5:5.

decisions.choice: "アロン" for Aaron
decisions.reason: Conventional Japanese form of the Old Testament name.

source.text: Οὕτως καὶ ὁ Χριστὸς οὐχ ἑαυτὸν ἐδόξασεν γενηθῆναι ἀρχιερέα, ἀλλ’ ὁ λαλήσας πρὸς αὐτόν· Υἱός μου εἶ σύ, ἐγὼ σήμερον γεγέννηκά σε·

records.literal_gloss: So also the Christ not himself glorified to become high priest, but the [one] having spoken to him: Son of me are you, I today have begotten you.

en.L: So also the {{christos:Christ|Messiah}} did not glorify {{deity_pronoun:himself|Himself}} to become high priest, but the one who spoke to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} [glorified {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}]: "You are {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} Son; I today have begotten {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}."
en.B: In the same way {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} did not give {{deity_pronoun:himself|Himself}} the glory of becoming high priest. That glory came from the one who said to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, "You are {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} Son; today I have fathered {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}."
en.R: In the same way, {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} did not take for {{deity_pronoun:himself|Himself}} the glory of being high priest. God gave it to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}. God said to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, "You are {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} Son. Today I have fathered {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}."

es.L: Así también el {{christos:Cristo|Mesías}} no se glorificó a {{deity_pronoun:sí mismo|Sí mismo}} para llegar a ser sumo sacerdote, sino el que {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} habló [{{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} glorificó]: «Tú eres {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} Hijo; yo hoy {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} he engendrado».
es.B: Del mismo modo, {{christos:Cristo|el Mesías}} no se dio a {{deity_pronoun:sí mismo|Sí mismo}} la gloria de llegar a ser sumo sacerdote. Esa gloria vino del que {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} dijo: «Tú eres {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} Hijo; hoy {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} he engendrado».
es.R: De la misma manera, {{christos:Cristo|el Mesías}} no tomó para {{deity_pronoun:sí|Sí}} la gloria de ser sumo sacerdote. Dios se la dio a {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}. Dios {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} dijo: «Tú eres {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} Hijo. Hoy he llegado a ser {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} Padre».

fr.L: Ainsi aussi le {{christos:Christ|Messie}} ne s’est pas glorifié {{deity_pronoun:lui-même|Lui-même}} pour devenir grand prêtre, mais celui qui {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} a parlé [{{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}a glorifié] : « Tu es {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} Fils ; aujourd’hui je {{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}ai engendré. »
fr.B: De même, le {{christos:Christ|Messie}} ne s’est pas attribué {{deity_pronoun:lui-même|Lui-même}} la gloire de devenir grand prêtre. Cette gloire {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} vient de celui qui {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} a dit : « Tu es {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} Fils ; aujourd’hui je {{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}ai engendré. »
fr.R: De la même manière, le {{christos:Christ|Messie}} ne s’est pas donné à {{deity_pronoun:lui-même|Lui-même}} la gloire d’être grand prêtre. C’est Dieu qui la {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} a donnée. Dieu {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} a dit : « Tu es {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} Fils. Aujourd’hui je suis devenu {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} Père. »

sw.L: Vivyo hivyo pia {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} hakujitukuza {{deity_pronoun:mwenyewe|Mwenyewe}} ili kuwa kuhani mkuu, bali yule aliyemwambia [alimtukuza]: "Wewe ni Mwana {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}; mimi leo nimekuzaa."
sw.B: Vivyo hivyo {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} hakujipa {{deity_pronoun:mwenyewe|Mwenyewe}} utukufu wa kuwa kuhani mkuu. Utukufu huo ulitoka kwa yule aliyemwambia, "Wewe ni Mwana {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}; leo nimekuzaa."
sw.R: Vivyo hivyo, {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} hakujichukulia {{deity_pronoun:mwenyewe|Mwenyewe}} utukufu wa kuwa kuhani mkuu. Mungu ndiye aliyempa. Mungu alimwambia, "Wewe ni Mwana {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}. Leo nimekuwa Baba {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}."

vi.L: Cũng vậy, {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}} đã không tự tôn vinh mình để trở thành thầy tế lễ thượng phẩm, nhưng [được tôn vinh bởi] Đấng đã phán với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}: "Con là Con {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}; ngày nay {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã sinh {{deity_pronoun:con|Con}}."
vi.B: Cũng vậy, {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}} đã không tự ban cho mình vinh quang làm thầy tế lễ thượng phẩm. Vinh quang ấy đến từ Đấng đã phán với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}: "Con là Con {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}; chính ngày nay {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã trở thành Cha của {{deity_pronoun:con|Con}}."
vi.R: Cũng vậy, {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}} đã không tự nhận lấy vinh quang làm thầy tế lễ thượng phẩm. Đức Chúa Trời đã ban vinh quang ấy cho {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Đức Chúa Trời đã phán với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}: "Con là Con {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}. Hôm nay {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã trở thành Cha của {{deity_pronoun:con|Con}}."

ko.L: 이와 같이 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}께서도 스스로 영광스럽게 하여 대제사장이 되지 않으셨고, 그분께 "너는 내 아들이다. 내가 오늘 너를 낳았다" 하고 말씀하신 분이 [그분을 영광스럽게 하셨습니다].
ko.B: 이와 같이 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}께서도 스스로 영광을 취하여 대제사장이 되신 것이 아닙니다. 그 영광은 그분께 "너는 내 아들이다. 바로 오늘 내가 너를 낳았다" 하고 말씀하신 분에게서 왔습니다.
ko.R: 마찬가지로 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}께서도 대제사장이 되는 영광을 스스로 차지하지 않으셨습니다. 하나님께서 그 영광을 그분께 주셨습니다. 하나님께서는 그분께 "너는 내 아들이다. 오늘 내가 너를 낳았다" 하고 말씀하셨습니다.

pt.L: Assim também o {{christos:Cristo|Messias}} não glorificou a {{deity_pronoun:si mesmo|Si mesmo}} para se tornar sumo sacerdote, mas aquele que {{deity_pronoun:lhe|Lhe}} disse [{{deity_pronoun:o|O}} glorificou]: "Tu és o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} Filho; eu hoje {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} gerei."
pt.B: Do mesmo modo, {{christos:Cristo|o Messias}} não deu a {{deity_pronoun:si mesmo|Si mesmo}} a glória de se tornar sumo sacerdote. Essa glória veio daquele que {{deity_pronoun:lhe|Lhe}} disse: "Tu és o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} Filho; hoje eu {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} gerei."
pt.R: Do mesmo modo, {{christos:Cristo|o Messias}} não tomou para {{deity_pronoun:si mesmo|Si mesmo}} a glória de ser sumo sacerdote. Deus a deu a {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}}. Deus {{deity_pronoun:lhe|Lhe}} disse: "Tu és o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} Filho. Hoje eu {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} tornei o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} Pai."

am.L: እንዲሁ ደግሞ {{christos:ክርስቶስ|መሲሑ}} ሊቀ ካህናት ለመሆን ራሱን አላከበረም፤ ነገር ግን፦ «አንተ ልጄ ነህ፤ እኔ ዛሬ ወልጄሃለሁ» ያለው [አከበረው]።
am.B: እንዲሁም {{christos:ክርስቶስ|መሲሑ}} ሊቀ ካህናት የመሆንን ክብር ለራሱ አልሰጠም። ያ ክብር የመጣው፦ «አንተ ልጄ ነህ፤ በዚህች ዕለት ወልጄሃለሁ» ካለው ነው።
am.R: እንዲሁም {{christos:ክርስቶስ|መሲሑ}} ሊቀ ካህናት የመሆንን ክብር ለራሱ አልወሰደም። እግዚአብሔር ሰጠው። እግዚአብሔር፦ «አንተ ልጄ ነህ። ዛሬ አባትህ ሆኛለሁ» አለው።

hi.L: इसी प्रकार मसीह ने भी महायाजक बनने के लिए अपनी महिमा आप नहीं की, पर जिन्होंने उनसे कहा, [उन्होंने की]: "तू मेरा पुत्र है; आज मैंने तुझे जन्म दिया है।"
hi.B: इसी तरह मसीह ने भी महायाजक बनने की महिमा अपने आप को नहीं दी। यह महिमा उनसे आई जिन्होंने उनसे कहा, "तू मेरा पुत्र है; आज मैंने तुझे जन्म दिया है।"
hi.R: इसी तरह मसीह ने भी महायाजक होने की महिमा अपने लिए नहीं ली। परमेश्वर ने उन्हें यह महिमा दी। परमेश्वर ने उनसे कहा, "तू मेरा पुत्र है। आज मैं तेरा पिता बन गया हूँ।"

ru.L: Так и {{christos:Христос|Мессия}} не сам себя прославил, чтобы стать первосвященником, но [прославил {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}}] сказавший {{deity_pronoun:ему|Ему}}: «Ты — Сын {{deity_pronoun:мой|Мой}}, {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} сегодня родил {{deity_pronoun:тебя|Тебя}}.»
ru.B: Так и {{christos:Христос|Мессия}} не сам присвоил себе славу стать первосвященником. Эта слава пришла от того, кто сказал {{deity_pronoun:ему|Ему}}: «Ты — {{deity_pronoun:мой|Мой}} Сын; сегодня {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} родил {{deity_pronoun:тебя|Тебя}}.»
ru.R: Так же и {{christos:Христос|Мессия}} не сам взял себе славу быть первосвященником. Бог дал {{deity_pronoun:ему|Ему}} её. Бог сказал {{deity_pronoun:ему|Ему}}: «Ты — {{deity_pronoun:мой|Мой}} Сын. Сегодня {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} стал {{deity_pronoun:твоим|Твоим}} Отцом.»

uk.L: Так і {{christos:Христос|Месія}} не сам себе прославив, щоб стати первосвящеником, а той, хто сказав до {{deity_pronoun:нього|Нього}} [прославив {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}}]: «Ти {{deity_pronoun:мій|Мій}} Син, {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} сьогодні породив {{deity_pronoun:тебе|Тебе}}.»
uk.B: Так само і {{christos:Христос|Месія}} не сам собі присвоїв славу стати первосвящеником. Цю славу дав {{deity_pronoun:йому|Йому}} той, хто сказав до {{deity_pronoun:нього|Нього}}: «Ти {{deity_pronoun:мій|Мій}} Син, сьогодні {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} породив {{deity_pronoun:тебе|Тебе}}.»
uk.R: Так само і {{christos:Христос|Месія}} не сам узяв собі славу бути первосвящеником. Бог дав {{deity_pronoun:йому|Йому}} цю славу. Бог сказав {{deity_pronoun:йому|Йому}}: «Ти {{deity_pronoun:мій|Мій}} Син. Сьогодні {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} став {{deity_pronoun:твоїм|Твоїм}} Батьком.»

ja.L: 同じように、{{christos:キリスト|メシア}}も、大祭司となる栄光を自分で得られたのではなく、ご自分に向かって、「あなたはわたしの子、わたしは今日、あなたを生んだ」と言われた方が[その栄光を与えられたのです]。
ja.B: 同じように、{{christos:キリスト|メシア}}も、大祭司となる栄光をご自分で取られたのではありません。その栄光は、「あなたはわたしの子。今日、わたしはあなたを生んだ」と言われた方から与えられたのです。
ja.R: 同じように、{{christos:キリスト|メシア}}も、大祭司になるという栄光を、ご自分で取られたのではありません。神がその栄光を与えられたのです。神はこう言われました。「あなたはわたしの子。今日、わたしはあなたの父となった。」

decisions.choice: Psalm 2:7
decisions.reason: The words are Psalm 2:7, already quoted in 1:5. In the psalm God speaks them to the king he has installed on Zion. The author reads them as God's words to the Son, and here sets them beside Psalm 110:4 (verse 6): the one God calls Son is the one God appoints priest. The Greek of the line follows the Hebrew closely.

decisions.choice: today: the day of the Son's appointment, which the author does not date
alternatives: the Son's eternal relationship to the Father
decisions.reason: In the psalm "today" is the king's coronation day. The author does not say which day he has in mind. Hebrews links the Son's appointment with his being raised and seated at God's right hand (1:3-5; 5:9-10; 7:28), and Acts 13:33 applies the same verse to the resurrection, but the text here does not settle it.

decisions.choice: but [he was glorified by] the one who spoke to him
alternatives: but the one who spoke to him [said]
decisions.reason: The second half has no verb of its own; "glorified" carries over from the first half. God, who spoke Psalm 2:7 to him, is the one who gave him the honor. ἐδόξασεν picks up "the honor" of verse 4.

decisions.choice: fathered
decisions.reason: γεγέννηκά is the ordinary verb for a father having a child. Literal keeps the traditional "begotten"; Balanced and Readable use the plainer "fathered". The verb describes the relationship God declares, not a physical birth (see the meaning decision on "today").

decisions.choice: God gave it to him. God said to him
decisions.reason: Readable names God, whom the Greek calls only "the one who spoke to him", and states the gift that the Greek implies.

decisions.choice: yo hoy te he engendrado (L), hoy te he engendrado (B), hoy he llegado a ser tu Padre (R)
decisions.reason: Psalm 2:7 is worded as at 1:5. "Engendrar" is the Spanish verb for a father having a child; Spanish has no plain equivalent of the English Balanced "fathered", so Balanced keeps "engendrado" with Literal. Readable states the relationship God declares, "I have become your Father", which does not suggest a physical birth (see the meaning decision on "today"); "te he hecho mi hijo" would read as adoption and is not used.

decisions.choice: deity_pronoun spans on free pronouns only (for the passage)
decisions.reason: Swahili marks most pronouns inside the verb ("aliyemwambia", "nimekuzaa"), and a prefix cannot take a capital. So only free pronouns and possessives ("mwenyewe", "wangu", "yako") carry the setting, and Swahili has fewer spans than the English.

decisions.choice: mimi leo nimekuzaa (L), leo nimekuzaa (B), leo nimekuwa Baba yako (R)
decisions.reason: As settled for Psalm 2:7 throughout Hebrews (1:5): Literal and Balanced keep the picture of begetting with "kuzaa"; Readable says what it means for a father, as the English Readable "fathered" does.

decisions.choice: aujourd’hui je t’ai engendré (L, B), aujourd’hui je suis devenu ton Père (R)
decisions.reason: The same wording as Psalm 2:7 in Hebrews 1:5, so the reader hears the quotation as a repeat. "Engendrer" is the word for a father’s begetting; the Readable says what it means for the Son, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: the Vietnamese of Psalm 2:7 in 1:5, at each level
decisions.reason: The same verse is quoted again (m1), so each level repeats its wording from 1:5.

decisions.choice: Psalm 2:7 worded as in 1:5 at each level
decisions.reason: The letter quotes the same verse twice, so the Korean is the same both times.

decisions.choice: Psalm 2:7 in the wording of 1:5 and Acts 13:33
decisions.reason: The same psalm verse as in 1:5, so each level keeps that wording, with God's intimate "तू" to the Son.

decisions.choice: no deity_pronoun spans; "मसीह" with no christos setting
decisions.reason: Devanagari has no capital letters, so the English deity_pronoun setting has nothing to change in Hindi; respect for God and Christ comes from the honorific third person. "मसीह" is both the name and the word Messiah, so the christos choice is already made (style guide, section 7). The same through this chapter.

decisions.choice: Psalm 2:7 as in 1:5 and Acts 13:33
decisions.reason: The same quotation as in 1:5, worded the same way at each level.

source.text: καθὼς καὶ ἐν ἑτέρῳ λέγει· Σὺ ἱερεὺς εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα κατὰ τὴν τάξιν Μελχισέδεκ, ὃς ἐν ταῖς ἡμέραις τῆς σαρκὸς αὐτοῦ δεήσεις τε καὶ ἱκετηρίας πρὸς τὸν δυνάμενον σῴζειν αὐτὸν ἐκ θανάτου μετὰ κραυγῆς ἰσχυρᾶς καὶ δακρύων προσενέγκας καὶ εἰσακουσθεὶς ἀπὸ τῆς εὐλαβείας, καίπερ ὢν υἱός, ἔμαθεν ἀφ’ ὧν ἔπαθεν τὴν ὑπακοήν, καὶ τελειωθεὶς ἐγένετο πᾶσιν τοῖς ὑπακούουσιν αὐτῷ αἴτιος σωτηρίας αἰωνίου, προσαγορευθεὶς ὑπὸ τοῦ θεοῦ ἀρχιερεὺς κατὰ τὴν τάξιν Μελχισέδεκ.

records.literal_gloss: as also in another he says: You [are] priest to the age according to the order Melchizedek, \v 7 who in the days of the flesh of him prayers both and supplications to the [one] being able to save him out of death with crying strong and tears having offered and having been heard from the reverence, \v 8 although being son, he learned from [the things] which he suffered the obedience, \v 9 and having been perfected he became to all those obeying him cause of salvation eternal, \v 10 having been designated by the God high priest according to the order Melchizedek.

en.L: As also in another [place] {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} says, "You [are] a priest forever according to the order of Melchizedek." \v 7 [It was {{deity_pronoun:he|He}}] who, in the days of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} flesh, having offered up both prayers and supplications with loud crying and tears to the one who was able to save {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} out of death, and having been heard because of [{{deity_pronoun:his|His}}] reverence, \v 8 although being a Son, learned obedience from the things which {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} suffered; \v 9 and having been made perfect, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} became to all those who obey {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} [the] cause of eternal salvation, \v 10 having been designated by God a high priest according to the order of Melchizedek.
en.B: As {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} also says in another place, "You are a priest forever, of the order of Melchizedek." \v 7 In the days of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} life in the flesh, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} offered up prayers and pleas, crying aloud and weeping, to the one who was able to save {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} out of death, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} was heard for {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} godly fear. \v 8 Even though {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} was a Son, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} learned obedience by the things {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} suffered. \v 9 And having been made perfect, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} became the cause of eternal salvation for everyone who obeys {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, \v 10 for God declared {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} a high priest of the order of Melchizedek.
en.R: And in another place God says to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, "You are a priest forever, the kind of priest Melchizedek was." \v 7 When Jesus lived on earth as a human being, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} cried out loudly to God with tears. He prayed and pleaded with the one who could save {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} out of death. And God heard {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, because {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} honored God with deep respect. \v 8 He was God's Son, and yet {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} learned what it is to obey through the things {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} suffered. \v 9 When {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} had been made complete, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} became the one who brings eternal salvation to all who obey {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}. \v 10 God named {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} a high priest, the kind of priest Melchizedek was.

es.L: Como también dice en otro [lugar]: «Tú [eres] sacerdote para siempre según el orden de Melquisedec». \v 7 [Es {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}] quien, en los días de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} carne, habiendo ofrecido oraciones y súplicas con clamor fuerte y lágrimas al que {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} podía salvar de la muerte, y habiendo sido escuchado a causa de [{{deity_pronoun:su|Su}}] reverencia, \v 8 aun siendo Hijo, aprendió la obediencia por las cosas que sufrió; \v 9 y habiendo sido hecho perfecto, llegó a ser para todos los que {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} obedecen [la] causa de salvación eterna, \v 10 habiendo sido designado por Dios sumo sacerdote según el orden de Melquisedec.
es.B: Como también dice en otro lugar: «Tú eres sacerdote para siempre, del orden de Melquisedec». \v 7 En los días de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} vida en la carne, ofreció oraciones y súplicas, clamando en alta voz y llorando, al que {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} podía salvar de la muerte, y fue escuchado por {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} reverencia a Dios. \v 8 Aunque era Hijo, aprendió la obediencia a través de lo que sufrió. \v 9 Y una vez hecho perfecto, llegó a ser la causa de la salvación eterna para todos los que {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} obedecen, \v 10 porque Dios {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} declaró sumo sacerdote del orden de Melquisedec.
es.R: Y en otro lugar Dios {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} dice: «Tú eres sacerdote para siempre, como Melquisedec era sacerdote». \v 7 Cuando Jesús vivió en la tierra como ser humano, clamó a Dios en voz alta y con lágrimas. Oró y suplicó al que {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} podía salvar de la muerte. Y Dios {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} escuchó, porque {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} honraba a Dios con profundo respeto. \v 8 Era el Hijo de Dios, y aun así aprendió lo que es obedecer por medio de lo que sufrió. \v 9 Cuando fue hecho completo, llegó a ser el que trae la salvación eterna a todos los que {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} obedecen. \v 10 Dios {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} nombró sumo sacerdote, como Melquisedec era sacerdote.

fr.L: Comme aussi dans un autre [passage] {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} dit : « Tu [es] prêtre pour l’éternité selon l’ordre de Melchisédek. » \v 7 [C’est {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}] qui, aux jours de {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} chair, ayant offert des prières et des supplications, avec un cri puissant et des larmes, à celui qui pouvait {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} sauver de la mort, et ayant été exaucé à cause de [{{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}}] piété, \v 8 bien qu’étant Fils, a appris l’obéissance par ce qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a souffert ; \v 9 et, ayant été rendu parfait, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} est devenu pour tous ceux qui {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} obéissent [la] cause d’un salut éternel, \v 10 ayant été désigné par Dieu grand prêtre selon l’ordre de Melchisédek.
fr.B: Comme {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} le dit aussi dans un autre passage : « Tu es prêtre pour toujours, de l’ordre de Melchisédek. » \v 7 Aux jours de {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} vie dans la chair, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a présenté des prières et des supplications, en criant avec force et en pleurant, à celui qui pouvait {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} sauver de la mort, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a été exaucé à cause de {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} piété. \v 8 Tout Fils qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} était, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a appris l’obéissance par ce qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a souffert. \v 9 Et, rendu parfait, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} est devenu la cause d’un salut éternel pour tous ceux qui {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} obéissent, \v 10 car Dieu {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}a proclamé grand prêtre de l’ordre de Melchisédek.
fr.R: Et dans un autre passage, Dieu {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} dit : « Tu es prêtre pour toujours, comme Melchisédek était prêtre. » \v 7 Quand Jésus vivait sur la terre comme un être humain, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a crié à Dieu avec force, en pleurant. Il a prié et supplié celui qui pouvait {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} sauver de la mort. Et Dieu {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}a entendu, parce qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} honorait Dieu avec un profond respect. \v 8 Il était le Fils de Dieu, et pourtant {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a appris ce que c’est qu’obéir à travers ce qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a souffert. \v 9 Une fois rendu complet, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} est devenu celui qui apporte le salut éternel à tous ceux qui {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} obéissent. \v 10 Dieu {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}a nommé grand prêtre, comme Melchisédek était prêtre.

sw.L: Kama vile pia mahali pengine anasema, "Wewe [ni] kuhani milele kwa utaratibu wa Melkizedeki." \v 7 [Ni {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}}] ambaye, katika siku za mwili {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}, alipokwisha kutoa sala na maombi pamoja na kilio kikuu na machozi kwa yule aliyeweza kumwokoa kutoka katika mauti, na akiwa amesikiwa kwa sababu ya kicho [{{deity_pronoun:chake|Chake}}], \v 8 ingawa alikuwa Mwana, alijifunza utii kutokana na mambo aliyoyateseka; \v 9 na akiwa amekamilishwa, akawa kwa wote wanaomtii [chanzo] cha wokovu wa milele, \v 10 akiwa ameitwa na Mungu kuhani mkuu kwa utaratibu wa Melkizedeki.
sw.B: Kama {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} pia anavyosema mahali pengine, "Wewe ni kuhani milele, wa utaratibu wa Melkizedeki." \v 7 Siku za maisha {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} katika mwili, alitoa sala na maombi, akilia kwa sauti kuu na kutokwa na machozi, kwa yule aliyeweza kumwokoa kutoka katika mauti, naye akasikiwa kwa sababu ya kumcha Mungu. \v 8 Ingawa alikuwa Mwana, alijifunza utii kwa mambo aliyoyateseka. \v 9 Naye akiisha kukamilishwa, akawa chanzo cha wokovu wa milele kwa kila mtu anayemtii, \v 10 kwa kuwa Mungu alimtangaza kuwa kuhani mkuu wa utaratibu wa Melkizedeki.
sw.R: Na mahali pengine Mungu anamwambia, "Wewe ni kuhani milele, kama Melkizedeki alivyokuwa kuhani." \v 7 Yesu alipoishi duniani akiwa mwanadamu, alimlilia Mungu kwa sauti kuu na kwa machozi. Aliomba na kumsihi yule ambaye angeweza kumwokoa kutoka katika mauti. Na Mungu alimsikia, kwa sababu {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} alimheshimu Mungu kwa kicho kikuu. \v 8 Yeye alikuwa Mwana wa Mungu, lakini kupitia mambo aliyoyateseka alijifunza maana ya kutii. \v 9 Alipokwisha kukamilishwa, akawa ndiye anayewaletea wokovu wa milele wote wanaomtii. \v 10 Mungu alimtaja kuwa kuhani mkuu, kama Melkizedeki alivyokuwa kuhani.

vi.L: Như ở chỗ khác {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} cũng phán: "Con là thầy tế lễ đời đời theo thứ bậc Mên-chi-xê-đéc." \v 7 [Chính {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}] là Đấng, trong những ngày sống trong xác thịt, đã dâng lên cả lời cầu nguyện lẫn lời nài xin, với tiếng kêu lớn và nước mắt, cho Đấng có thể cứu {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} ra khỏi sự chết, và đã được nhậm vì lòng kính sợ [của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}], \v 8 dù là Con, đã học sự vâng phục qua những điều {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} chịu khổ; \v 9 và sau khi được làm cho trọn vẹn, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã trở thành nguồn cứu rỗi đời đời cho mọi người vâng phục {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, \v 10 vì đã được Đức Chúa Trời gọi là thầy tế lễ thượng phẩm theo thứ bậc Mên-chi-xê-đéc.
vi.B: Ở một chỗ khác {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} cũng phán: "Con là thầy tế lễ đời đời, theo thứ bậc Mên-chi-xê-đéc." \v 7 Trong những ngày {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sống trong thân xác loài người, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã dâng lên những lời cầu nguyện và nài xin, với tiếng kêu lớn và nước mắt, cho Đấng có thể cứu {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} ra khỏi sự chết, và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã được nhậm vì lòng kính sợ Đức Chúa Trời. \v 8 Dù là Con, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã học sự vâng phục qua những điều {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} chịu khổ. \v 9 Và sau khi được làm cho trọn vẹn, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã trở thành nguồn cứu rỗi đời đời cho mọi người vâng phục {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, \v 10 vì Đức Chúa Trời đã tuyên bố {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} là thầy tế lễ thượng phẩm theo thứ bậc Mên-chi-xê-đéc.
vi.R: Ở một chỗ khác Đức Chúa Trời phán với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}: "Con là thầy tế lễ đời đời, như Mên-chi-xê-đéc đã làm thầy tế lễ." \v 7 Khi Đức Giê-xu sống trên đất như một con người, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã khóc và kêu lớn tiếng với Đức Chúa Trời. Ngài cầu nguyện và nài xin Đấng có thể cứu {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} ra khỏi sự chết. Và Đức Chúa Trời đã nghe {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, vì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} hết lòng kính sợ Đức Chúa Trời. \v 8 Ngài là Con của Đức Chúa Trời, thế mà {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã học biết thế nào là vâng phục qua những điều {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} chịu khổ. \v 9 Khi đã được làm cho hoàn toàn, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} trở thành Đấng đem sự cứu rỗi đời đời đến cho mọi người vâng phục {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. \v 10 Đức Chúa Trời đã gọi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} là thầy tế lễ thượng phẩm, như Mên-chi-xê-đéc đã làm thầy tế lễ.

ko.L: 또 다른 곳에서 말씀하시는 것과 같습니다. "너는 멜기세덱의 계열을 따라 영원히 제사장이다." \v 7 그분은 육신으로 계시던 날들에, 자기를 죽음에서 구원하실 수 있는 분께 큰 부르짖음과 눈물로 기도와 간구를 올리셨고, 그분의 경외하심 때문에 [하나님께서] 들어 주셨습니다. \v 8 그분은 아들이셨지만, 받으신 고난을 통하여 순종을 배우셨습니다. \v 9 그리고 완전하게 되신 뒤에, 그분께 순종하는 모든 사람에게 영원한 구원의 근원이 되셨습니다. \v 10 하나님께서 그분을 멜기세덱의 계열을 따른 대제사장이라고 부르셨습니다.
ko.B: 또 다른 곳에서도 이렇게 말씀하십니다. "너는 멜기세덱의 계열에 속한 영원한 제사장이다." \v 7 그분은 육신으로 사시던 때에, 자기를 죽음에서 구원하실 수 있는 분께 큰 소리로 부르짖으며 눈물로 기도하시고 간구하셨습니다. 그리고 그분의 경외하는 마음 때문에 하나님께서 그 기도를 들어 주셨습니다. \v 8 그분은 아들이셨지만, 고난을 받으심으로써 순종을 배우셨습니다. \v 9 그리고 완전하게 되신 뒤에, 그분께 순종하는 모든 사람에게 영원한 구원의 근원이 되셨습니다. \v 10 하나님께서 그분을 멜기세덱의 계열에 속한 대제사장으로 선언하셨기 때문입니다.
ko.R: 또 다른 곳에서 하나님께서는 그분께 이렇게 말씀하십니다. "너는 영원한 제사장이다. 멜기세덱과 같은 제사장이다." \v 7 예수께서는 이 땅에서 사람으로 사실 때, 눈물을 흘리시며 큰 소리로 하나님께 부르짖으셨습니다. 그분은 자기를 죽음에서 구원하실 수 있는 분께 기도하고 간절히 비셨습니다. 그리고 하나님께서는 그분의 기도를 들으셨습니다. 그분이 하나님을 깊이 경외하셨기 때문입니다. \v 8 그분은 하나님의 아들이셨지만, 고난을 겪으시면서 순종한다는 것이 무엇인지 배우셨습니다. \v 9 그분은 온전하게 되신 뒤에, 그분께 순종하는 모든 사람에게 영원한 구원을 주시는 분이 되셨습니다. \v 10 하나님께서는 그분을 대제사장이라고 부르셨습니다. 멜기세덱과 같은 대제사장이라고 부르셨습니다.

pt.L: Como também em outro [lugar] {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} diz: "Tu [és] sacerdote para sempre, segundo a ordem de Melquisedeque." \v 7 [Foi {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}}] quem, nos dias da {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} carne, tendo oferecido tanto orações quanto súplicas, com forte clamor e lágrimas, àquele que podia salvá-{{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} da morte, e tendo sido ouvido por causa da [{{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}}] reverência, \v 8 embora sendo Filho, aprendeu a obediência pelas coisas que sofreu; \v 9 e, tendo sido aperfeiçoado, {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} se tornou para todos os que {{deity_pronoun:lhe|Lhe}} obedecem [a] causa de salvação eterna, \v 10 tendo sido designado por Deus sumo sacerdote segundo a ordem de Melquisedeque.
pt.B: Como {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} também diz em outro lugar: "Tu és sacerdote para sempre, da ordem de Melquisedeque." \v 7 Nos dias da {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} vida na carne, {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} ofereceu orações e súplicas, clamando em alta voz e chorando, àquele que podia salvá-{{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} da morte, e foi ouvido por causa do {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} temor a Deus. \v 8 Mesmo sendo Filho, {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} aprendeu a obediência por meio das coisas que sofreu. \v 9 E, tendo sido levado à perfeição, {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} se tornou a causa da salvação eterna para todos os que {{deity_pronoun:lhe|Lhe}} obedecem, \v 10 pois Deus {{deity_pronoun:o|O}} proclamou sumo sacerdote da ordem de Melquisedeque.
pt.R: E em outro lugar Deus {{deity_pronoun:lhe|Lhe}} diz: "Tu és sacerdote para sempre, o mesmo tipo de sacerdote que Melquisedeque foi." \v 7 Quando Jesus viveu na terra como ser humano, {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} clamou a Deus em alta voz e com lágrimas. Ele orou e suplicou àquele que podia salvá-{{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} da morte. E Deus {{deity_pronoun:o|O}} ouviu, porque {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} honrava a Deus com profundo respeito. \v 8 Ele era o Filho de Deus, e mesmo assim aprendeu o que é obedecer por meio das coisas que sofreu. \v 9 Quando {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} chegou a ser tudo o que devia ser, {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} se tornou aquele que traz a salvação eterna a todos os que {{deity_pronoun:lhe|Lhe}} obedecem. \v 10 Deus {{deity_pronoun:o|O}} chamou de sumo sacerdote, o mesmo tipo de sacerdote que Melquisedeque foi.

am.L: በሌላም [ስፍራ] ደግሞ እንዲህ እንደሚል፦ «አንተ እንደ መልከ ጼዴቅ ሥርዓት ለዘላለም ካህን [ነህ]።» \v 7 እርሱም በሥጋው ወራት ከሞት ሊያድነው ወደሚችለው በብርቱ ጩኸትና በእንባ ጸሎትንና ልመናን አቅርቦ፣ ስለ አክብሮቱም ተሰምቶለት፣ \v 8 ምንም እንኳ ልጅ ቢሆን፣ ከተቀበለው መከራ መታዘዝን ተማረ፤ \v 9 ፍጹምም ሆኖ ለሚታዘዙት ሁሉ የዘላለም መዳን ምክንያት ሆነ፤ \v 10 እግዚአብሔርም እንደ መልከ ጼዴቅ ሥርዓት ሊቀ ካህናት ብሎ ሰየመው።
am.B: በሌላ ስፍራም ደግሞ እንዲህ ይላል፦ «አንተ እንደ መልከ ጼዴቅ ሥርዓት ለዘላለም ካህን ነህ።» \v 7 እርሱ በሥጋ በኖረበት ዘመን ከሞት ሊያድነው ወደሚችለው እየጮኸና እያለቀሰ ጸሎትንና ልመናን አቀረበ፤ እግዚአብሔርንም በመፍራቱ ተሰማለት። \v 8 ወልድ ቢሆንም እንኳ፣ በተቀበለው መከራ መታዘዝን ተማረ። \v 9 ፍጹምም ከሆነ በኋላ ለሚታዘዙት ሁሉ የዘላለም መዳን ምክንያት ሆነ፤ \v 10 እግዚአብሔር እንደ መልከ ጼዴቅ ሥርዓት ሊቀ ካህናት ብሎ ሰይሞታልና።
am.R: በሌላ ስፍራም እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይለዋል፦ «አንተ ለዘላለም ካህን ነህ፤ መልከ ጼዴቅ እንደ ነበረው ዓይነት ካህን ነህ።» \v 7 ኢየሱስ በምድር ላይ እንደ ሰው በኖረ ጊዜ፣ በእንባ ወደ እግዚአብሔር አጥብቆ ጮኸ። ከሞት ሊያድነው ወደሚችለው ጸለየ፤ ለመነም። እግዚአብሔርም ሰማው፤ ኢየሱስ ለእግዚአብሔር ጥልቅ አክብሮት ነበረውና። \v 8 እርሱ የእግዚአብሔር ልጅ ነበረ፤ ቢሆንም በተቀበለው መከራ መታዘዝ ምን እንደ ሆነ ተማረ። \v 9 ፍጹም ብቁ ከሆነ በኋላ ለሚታዘዙት ሁሉ የዘላለምን መዳን የሚያመጣ ሆነ። \v 10 እግዚአብሔር መልከ ጼዴቅ እንደ ነበረው ዓይነት ሊቀ ካህናት ብሎ ሰየመው።

hi.L: जैसे वे दूसरी [जगह] भी कहते हैं, "तू युगानुयुग मलिकिसिदक की रीति के अनुसार याजक [है]।" \v 7 उन्होंने अपनी देह में रहने के दिनों में ऊँचे स्वर से पुकार-पुकारकर और आँसू बहा-बहाकर उनसे, जो उन्हें मृत्यु से बचा सकते थे, प्रार्थनाएँ और विनतियाँ कीं, और [अपनी] भक्ति के कारण उनकी सुनी गई; \v 8 और पुत्र होने पर भी उन्होंने उन बातों से जो उन्होंने सहीं, आज्ञा मानना सीखा; \v 9 और सिद्ध किए जाकर वे उन सब के लिए जो उनकी आज्ञा मानते हैं, अनन्त उद्धार का कारण बन गए, \v 10 और परमेश्वर ने उन्हें मलिकिसिदक की रीति के अनुसार महायाजक कहकर पुकारा।
hi.B: जैसे वे एक और जगह भी कहते हैं, "तू सदा के लिए याजक है, मलिकिसिदक की रीति का।" \v 7 शरीर में अपने जीवन के दिनों में उन्होंने ऊँचे स्वर से पुकारकर और आँसू बहाकर उनसे प्रार्थनाएँ और विनतियाँ कीं जो उन्हें मृत्यु से बचा सकते थे, और उनकी भक्ति के कारण उनकी सुनी गई। \v 8 यद्यपि वे पुत्र थे, फिर भी उन्होंने अपने दुःखों के द्वारा आज्ञा मानना सीखा। \v 9 और सिद्ध किए जाकर वे उन सब के लिए अनन्त उद्धार का कारण बन गए जो उनकी आज्ञा मानते हैं, \v 10 क्योंकि परमेश्वर ने उन्हें मलिकिसिदक की रीति का महायाजक घोषित किया।
hi.R: और एक और जगह परमेश्वर उनसे कहते हैं, "तू सदा के लिए याजक है, ठीक वैसा याजक जैसा मलिकिसिदक था।" \v 7 जब यीशु पृथ्वी पर मनुष्य बनकर रहे, तो उन्होंने आँसू बहाते हुए ऊँचे स्वर से परमेश्वर को पुकारा। उन्होंने उनसे प्रार्थना और विनती की, जो उन्हें मृत्यु से बचा सकते थे। और परमेश्वर ने उनकी सुनी, क्योंकि वे गहरी श्रद्धा से परमेश्वर का आदर करते थे। \v 8 वे परमेश्वर के पुत्र थे, फिर भी जो दुःख उन्होंने सहे, उनके द्वारा उन्होंने सीखा कि आज्ञा मानना क्या होता है। \v 9 जब वे पूरी तरह योग्य बना दिए गए, तो वे उन सब के लिए अनन्त उद्धार लानेवाले बन गए जो उनकी आज्ञा मानते हैं। \v 10 परमेश्वर ने उन्हें महायाजक का नाम दिया, ठीक वैसा याजक जैसा मलिकिसिदक था।

ru.L: Как и в другом [месте] {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} говорит: «Ты — священник навеки по чину Мелхиседека.» \v 7 [Это {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}}], который во дни {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} плоти, принеся молитвы и моления с сильным воплем и слезами могущему спасти {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} от смерти и будучи услышан за [{{deity_pronoun:его|Его}}] благоговение, \v 8 хотя и был Сыном, научился послушанию из того, что претерпел; \v 9 и, достигнув совершенства, {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} стал для всех послушных {{deity_pronoun:ему|Ему}} причиной вечного спасения, \v 10 будучи наречён Богом первосвященником по чину Мелхиседека.
ru.B: Как {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} говорит и в другом месте: «Ты — священник навеки по чину Мелхиседека.» \v 7 В дни {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} жизни во плоти {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} с громким воплем и слезами возносил молитвы и мольбы тому, кто мог спасти {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} от смерти, и {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} был услышан за {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} благоговейный страх. \v 8 Хотя {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} был Сыном, {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} научился послушанию через то, что претерпел. \v 9 И, достигнув совершенства, {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} стал источником вечного спасения для всех, кто {{deity_pronoun:ему|Ему}} послушен, \v 10 ведь Бог провозгласил {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} первосвященником по чину Мелхиседека.
ru.R: А в другом месте Бог говорит {{deity_pronoun:ему|Ему}}: «Ты — священник навеки, такой же, каким был Мелхиседек.» \v 7 Когда Иисус жил на земле как человек, {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} громко взывал к Богу со слезами. Он молился и умолял того, кто мог спасти {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} от смерти. И Бог услышал {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}}, потому что {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} чтил Бога с глубоким благоговением. \v 8 Он был Божьим Сыном, и всё же {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} узнал, что значит слушаться, через то, что претерпел. \v 9 Когда {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} стал совершенным, {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} стал тем, кто приносит вечное спасение всем, кто {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} слушается. \v 10 Бог назвал {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} первосвященником, таким же, каким был Мелхиседек.

uk.L: Як і в іншому [місці] {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} каже: «Ти священник навіки за чином Мелхиседека.» \v 7 [Це {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}}], хто за днів своєї плоті, принісши молитви і благання з гучним криком і слізьми тому, хто міг спасти {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} від смерті, і бувши почутим через [свою] благоговійність, \v 8 хоч і був Сином, навчився послуху з того, що вистраждав; \v 9 і, ставши досконалим, {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} став для всіх, хто {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} слухається, причиною вічного спасіння, \v 10 названий Богом первосвящеником за чином Мелхиседека.
uk.B: Як {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} каже і в іншому місці: «Ти священник навіки за чином Мелхиседека.» \v 7 За днів свого земного життя {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} з гучним криком і слізьми приносив молитви й благання тому, хто міг спасти {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} від смерті, і {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} був почутий за свою побожність. \v 8 Хоч {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} і був Сином, {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} навчився послуху з того, що вистраждав. \v 9 І, ставши досконалим, {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} став причиною вічного спасіння для кожного, хто {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} слухається, \v 10 бо Бог проголосив {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} первосвящеником за чином Мелхиседека.
uk.R: І в іншому місці Бог каже {{deity_pronoun:йому|Йому}}: «Ти священник навіки, такий священник, яким був Мелхиседек.» \v 7 Коли Ісус жив на землі як людина, {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} гучно кликав до Бога зі слізьми. Він молився і благав того, хто міг спасти {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} від смерті. І Бог почув {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}}, бо {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} глибоко шанував Бога. \v 8 Він був Божим Сином, і все ж {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} навчився, що означає слухатися, через те, що вистраждав. \v 9 Коли {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} став досконалим, {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} став тим, хто дає вічне спасіння всім, хто {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} слухається. \v 10 Бог назвав {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} первосвящеником, таким священником, яким був Мелхиседек.

ja.L: また、別の[箇所]でも、こう言われているとおりです。「あなたは、メルキゼデクの位に従って、永遠に祭司である。」\v 7 この方は、肉[において生きられた]日々に、ご自分を死から救うことのできる方に、激しい叫びと涙をもって祈りと願いをささげ、その畏れ敬う心のゆえに聞き入れられました。\v 8 子であるにもかかわらず、苦しまれたことによって従順を学ばれました。\v 9 そして、完全な者とされて、ご自分に従うすべての人々にとって、永遠の救いの源となられ、\v 10 神によって、メルキゼデクの位に従う大祭司と呼ばれたのです。
ja.B: また、別の箇所でも、こう言われています。「あなたは、メルキゼデクに連なる、永遠の祭司である。」\v 7 この方は、肉体をもって生きておられた日々に、ご自分を死から救うことのできる方に向かって、大きな叫び声をあげ、涙を流しながら、祈りと願いをささげられました。そして、その神を畏れ敬う心のゆえに、聞き入れられました。\v 8 この方は御子であるのに、苦しみを通して従順を学ばれました。\v 9 そして、完全な者とされて、ご自分に従うすべての人々にとって、永遠の救いの源となられたのです。\v 10 神が、この方をメルキゼデクに連なる大祭司と呼ばれたからです。
ja.R: また別の箇所で、神は御子にこう言われます。「あなたはいつまでも祭司である。メルキゼデクのような祭司である。」\v 7 イエスは、人間としてこの地上で生きておられたとき、大声で叫び、涙を流して神に祈られました。ご自分を死から救うことのできる神に、心から願い求められたのです。そして神は、その祈りを聞いてくださいました。イエスが、深い敬いの心をもって神を大切にしておられたからです。\v 8 イエスは神の御子でしたが、苦しみを通して、神に従うとはどういうことかを学ばれました。\v 9 こうして完全な方とされたイエスは、ご自分に従うすべての人に、永遠の救いを与える方となられました。\v 10 神はイエスを大祭司と呼ばれました。メルキゼデクのような大祭司です。

decisions.choice: Psalm 110:4 (109:4 Greek)
decisions.reason: The line is Psalm 110:4, from the psalm whose first verse the author quoted in 1:13. "In another [place]" means another psalm: the speaker is still God, who spoke Psalm 2:7 in verse 5. In the psalm the line is introduced as an oath ("the LORD has sworn and will not change his mind"); the author quotes that part in 7:21. The Greek follows the Hebrew closely. Melchizedek appears in Genesis 14:18-20 as king of Salem and priest of God Most High; chapter 7 explains what the comparison means.

decisions.choice: according to the order of Melchizedek: a priest of the same kind or rank as Melchizedek
decisions.reason: τάξιν means an order, rank or arrangement. It does not mean descent: 7:3 stresses that Melchizedek has no recorded ancestry, and 7:15 restates the phrase as "in the likeness of Melchizedek". The priest of the psalm is a priest like Melchizedek, not one of Aaron's line.

decisions.choice: the days of his flesh: his mortal human life
alternatives: the days when he was subject to sinful desires
decisions.reason: Here "flesh" means human life in its frailty and mortality, as in 2:14 ("blood and flesh"). It says nothing of sin; 4:15 says he was without sin.

decisions.choice: prayers with loud cries and tears: the Gospels' account of Gethsemane, and perhaps the cross
alternatives: a general description of his life of prayer
decisions.reason: Prayer to the one able to save him from death recalls Jesus' prayer in Gethsemane that the cup might pass from him (Matthew 26:36-46; Mark 14:32-42; Luke 22:39-46). The Gospels do not mention tears there, and the loud cry fits the cross (Mark 15:34, 37), so the author may have the whole passion in view. The language also echoes the psalms of the righteous sufferer who cries to God (Psalm 22:2-3, 25). The author names no scene.

decisions.choice: he was heard because of his reverence; God answered by bringing him out of death, not by sparing him from dying
alternatives: he was heard and set free from his fear
he was heard and spared from dying
decisions.reason: ἀπὸ with εὐλαβείας most naturally gives the reason he was heard: his reverent submission to God (the same noun family in 12:28 for worship "with reverence and awe"). Some take it as "heard [and delivered] from his fear", but the noun elsewhere means devout reverence, not terror. Jesus still died, so the answer is that God brought him out of death (the Greek preposition is ἐκ, "out of"), raising him (13:20). The translation keeps "save him out of death" at every level.

decisions.choice: he learned obedience: he came to know by experience what obedience to God costs
alternatives: he moved from disobedience to obedience
decisions.reason: The Greek plays on two similar verbs, ἔμαθεν ("he learned") and ἔπαθεν ("he suffered"). It does not imply he had been disobedient: 4:15 says he was without sin. Even though he was the Son, who might have been expected to be spared, he obeyed the Father through suffering and so learned obedience by doing it (compare Philippians 2:8; 10:5-10).

decisions.choice: made perfect: brought to the goal, fully fitted for his office as Savior and high priest
decisions.reason: As at 2:10, τελειόω means to bring something to completion. Through suffering, death and exaltation, the Son was made fully what he was appointed to be, the high priest who saves. It is not moral improvement; he was always without sin (4:15; 7:26-28).

decisions.choice: cause of eternal salvation: the one through whom it comes about
decisions.reason: αἴτιος means the one responsible for something, its cause. Compare 2:10, where he is the "pioneer" of salvation. "Eternal" contrasts this salvation with the repeated, temporary results of the old sacrifices (9:12, 9:15).

decisions.choice: having been designated: God addressed him as high priest, in the words of Psalm 110:4
alternatives: after he had become high priest he was called so
decisions.reason: προσαγορευθεὶς means to address someone by a title or to name them publicly. The participle explains verse 9: he is the cause of eternal salvation as the high priest whom God declared him to be. The verse repeats Psalm 110:4 and leads back to it in 6:20 and chapter 7.

decisions.choice: of the order of Melchizedek (Balanced); the kind of priest Melchizedek was (Readable)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps "according to the order of". Balanced says "of the order of", which reads naturally. Readable states the sense (a priest of the same kind), since "order" in this sense is unfamiliar and "line" would suggest descent.

decisions.choice: godly fear
decisions.reason: εὐλαβείας is the awe and devotion of someone who fears God. "Godly fear" says that in two plain words; Literal has "reverence".

decisions.choice: God says ... When Jesus lived ... God heard him ... God's Son
decisions.reason: Readable names Jesus and God where the Greek uses "who", "he" and "the one who was able", and turns the passive "he was heard" into "God heard him", since the long Greek sentence is broken into short ones.

decisions.choice: made complete
decisions.reason: Readable says "made complete" for τελειόω (Literal and Balanced: "made perfect"), because "perfect" can sound as if he had faults that needed fixing. See the meaning decision on the word.

decisions.choice: he learned what it is to obey
decisions.reason: Readable spells out "learned obedience" in plain words; it means he learned by experience what obeying God involves.

decisions.choice: según el orden de Melquisedec (L), del orden de Melquisedec (B), como Melquisedec era sacerdote (R)
decisions.reason: Settled for Hebrews (5:6, 5:10, 6:20 and chapter 7). "El orden" (masculine) is a rank or kind; "la orden" would suggest a religious order or a command, and "línea" would suggest descent, which 7:3 rules out. Readable says what the phrase means: a priest of the same kind as Melchizedek.

decisions.choice: kwa utaratibu wa Melkizedeki (L), wa utaratibu wa Melkizedeki (B), kama Melkizedeki alivyokuwa kuhani (R)
decisions.reason: The wording settled for Psalm 110:4 throughout Hebrews. "Utaratibu" (order, arrangement) keeps the idea of a kind or rank of priest; Readable says it plainly, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: chanzo cha wokovu wa milele
decisions.reason: "Sababu" in Swahili is mostly a reason or explanation; "chanzo" (source, origin) says that salvation comes about through him, as the meaning decision has it. Readable says "anayewaletea" (the one who brings).

decisions.choice: selon l’ordre de Melchisédek (L), de l’ordre de Melchisédek (B), comme Melchisédek était prêtre (R)
decisions.reason: Settled for the whole book. Literal keeps the preposition and "ordre"; Balanced keeps "ordre" in a shorter phrase; Readable says what the phrase means, a priest of the kind Melchizedek was, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: rendu parfait (L, B), rendu complet (R)
decisions.reason: "Rendre parfait" is the book’s term at Literal and Balanced. The Readable follows the English "made complete"; "rendu complet" is unusual of a person in French, and a native reviewer may prefer a phrase such as "pleinement prêt pour sa tâche", which says the meaning decision’s "fully fitted for his office".

decisions.choice: passé composé for the past events of Christ’s life (a présenté, a appris, a souffert)
alternatives: passé simple at Literal and Balanced
decisions.reason: Verses 7-10 are part of the author’s argument, not a narrative passage, so French uses the tense of discourse at every level. The passé simple is kept for narrative passages (6:13-15, chapters 7 and 11).

decisions.choice: "theo thứ bậc Mên-chi-xê-đéc" (L, B); "như Mên-chi-xê-đéc đã làm thầy tế lễ" (R), through 5:6-7:21; "Con" in God's words to him
decisions.reason: The phrase means a priest of the same kind or rank as Melchizedek (m2). "Thứ bậc" says rank; "ban" is the word the Vietnamese Luke keeps for a priestly division (1:5), and "dòng" would suggest descent, which 7:3 and 7:6 deny. Readable says what kind of priest, as the English Readable does. "Mên-chi-xê-đéc" is the Protestant form of the name. God speaks to the king of Psalm 110 as "Con", as in 1:13.

decisions.choice: "trong những ngày sống trong xác thịt" (L); "sống trong thân xác loài người" (B); "sống trên đất như một con người" (R)
decisions.reason: The days of his flesh are his mortal human life (m3), not "flesh" as the power of sin that the Vietnamese letters call "xác thịt". Literal keeps the word but makes it his life in the flesh; Balanced and Readable say "a human body" and "a human being".

decisions.choice: "nguồn cứu rỗi đời đời" (L, B); "Đấng đem sự cứu rỗi đời đời đến" (R)
decisions.reason: The cause of salvation is the one through whom it comes about (m8). "Nguồn" (source) says that plainly; "đời đời" is the style guide's word for eternal.

decisions.choice: "멜기세덱의 계열을 따라" (L), "멜기세덱의 계열에 속한" (B), "멜기세덱과 같은 제사장" (R), here and through chapters 6-7
decisions.reason: The order of Melchizedek means a priest of the same kind or rank as Melchizedek (meaning decision). "반차" is the word of the older Korean Bibles and is no longer understood; "계열" (line, order) says a rank of priests, and Readable says what it means, as the English Readable does. The name is in its Protestant form.

decisions.choice: "육신으로 계시던 날들" (L), "육신으로 사시던 때" (B), "이 땅에서 사람으로 사실 때" (R); "경외" for his reverence
decisions.reason: The days of his flesh are his mortal human life (meaning decision); "육신" is the Korean John's and letters' word for human nature (John 1:14; 1 John 4:2). Reverence is godly fear, which "경외" says.

decisions.choice: Melquisedeque; segundo a ordem de Melquisedeque (L); da ordem de Melquisedeque (B); o mesmo tipo de sacerdote que Melquisedeque foi (R)
decisions.reason: For the whole book (5:6-7:28). "Melquisedeque" is the Brazilian spelling of the name (as Abraão, Isaque). "Ordem" means rank or kind, not descent (m2), so Readable says "o mesmo tipo de sacerdote", as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: Quando ele chegou a ser tudo o que devia ser
decisions.reason: Literal "aperfeiçoado" and Balanced "levado à perfeição" keep the word family of 2:10 and 5:14; Readable states its sense (m7), fully made what he was appointed to be, since "perfeito" would suggest faults that needed fixing and "tornado completo" is clumsy in Portuguese.

decisions.choice: እንደ መልከ ጼዴቅ ሥርዓት (according to the order of Melchizedek); Readable: መልከ ጼዴቅ እንደ ነበረው ዓይነት ካህን
decisions.reason: The name is spelled መልከ ጼዴቅ, as in the Ethiopian Bible tradition, throughout Hebrews. ሥርዓት (order, rank) says that Christ is a priest of the same kind as Melchizedek (meaning decision m2); Readable says it plainly.

decisions.choice: በሥጋው ወራት (L); በሥጋ በኖረበት ዘመን (B): flesh as ሥጋ
decisions.reason: As in Paul, flesh is ሥጋ at Literal and Balanced; here it is his mortal human life (meaning decision m3), which Readable says outright.

decisions.choice: "तू" in Psalm 110:4
decisions.reason: God speaks to the Son, and the author reads this verse together with Psalm 2:7 (verse 5), so the intimate "तू" of Acts 13:33 is kept. Psalm 110:1, quoted in 1:13, keeps the wording of Luke and Acts with "तुम".

decisions.choice: "मलिकिसिदक"; "की रीति के अनुसार" (L); "की रीति का" (B); "वैसा याजक जैसा मलिकिसिदक था" (R)
decisions.reason: The established Hindi Bible form of the name. A priest of the same kind or rank as Melchizedek (meaning decision m2): "रीति" is order or manner, and Readable says the sense plainly, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "अपनी देह में रहने के दिनों में" (L); "शरीर में अपने जीवन के दिनों में" (B); "पृथ्वी पर मनुष्य बनकर" (R)
decisions.reason: The days of his flesh are his mortal human life (meaning decision m3). Balanced keeps "शरीर", the key term for flesh; Literal says it with "देह" so that "शरीर के दिनों" does not suggest only his body, and Readable explains it.

decisions.choice: "सिद्ध किए जाकर" (L, B); "पूरी तरह योग्य बना दिए गए" (R)
decisions.reason: Key term, as in 2:10: brought to the goal, fully fitted for his office (meaning decision m7).

decisions.choice: по чину Мелхиседека (L, B); такой же, каким был Мелхиседек (R)
decisions.reason: "По чину" is the traditional phrase for a priest of the same kind or rank (m2), still understood; Readable says what it means. The name is "Мелхиседек" through the letter.

decisions.choice: во дни его плоти (L); в дни его жизни во плоти (B)
decisions.reason: sarx is "плоть" at Literal and Balanced; here it means his mortal human life (m3), which Balanced brings out with "жизни во плоти" and Readable says plainly.

decisions.choice: "за чином Мелхиседека" (L, B); "такий священник, яким був Мелхиседек" (R)
decisions.reason: "Чин" is the Ukrainian word for an order or rank of priesthood and says "of the same kind and rank" (m2); "порядок" would mean a sequence. Readable explains it, as the English does. Kept through 6:20-7:17.

decisions.choice: "за днів свого земного життя"
decisions.reason: "Плоть" in Balanced could suggest sinful nature; the meaning decision reads the phrase as his mortal human life, which "земне життя" says.

decisions.choice: "メルキゼデクの位に従って" (L); "メルキゼデクに連なる" (B); "メルキゼデクのような" (R)
decisions.reason: The phrase means a priest of the same kind or rank as Melchizedek; Literal keeps "order" as "位", Balanced says he belongs to that line of priesthood, Readable compares, as the English Readable does. The name takes the conventional Japanese form; used through chapter 7.

decisions.choice: "肉[において生きられた]日々" (L), "肉体をもって生きておられた日々" (B), "人間としてこの地上で生きておられたとき" (R); "畏れ敬う心" for eulabeia
decisions.reason: "The days of his flesh" means his mortal life, not Paul's moral sense of flesh; "畏れ敬う" is reverent fear of God, not terror.

source.text: Περὶ οὗ πολὺς ἡμῖν ὁ λόγος καὶ δυσερμήνευτος λέγειν, ἐπεὶ νωθροὶ γεγόνατε ταῖς ἀκοαῖς·

records.literal_gloss: Concerning which much for us the word and hard-to-explain to say, since sluggish you have become in the hearings.

en.L: Concerning which our message [is] long and hard to explain in the telling, since you have become sluggish in [your] ears.
en.B: About this we have a great deal to say, and it is hard to put into words, because you have become sluggish listeners.
en.R: We have a lot to say about this, but it is hard to explain to you, because you have become lazy about listening.

es.L: Acerca de lo cual nuestro mensaje [es] largo y difícil de explicar al decir[lo], puesto que {{plural_you:se han vuelto|os habéis vuelto}} tardos de oídos.
es.B: Sobre esto tenemos mucho que decir, y es difícil de explicar, porque {{plural_you:se han vuelto|os habéis vuelto}} lentos para escuchar.
es.R: Tenemos mucho que decir sobre esto, pero es difícil {{plural_you:explicárselo|explicároslo}}, porque {{plural_you:se han vuelto|os habéis vuelto}} perezosos para escuchar.

fr.L: Au sujet de quoi notre discours [est] long et difficile à expliquer, puisque vous êtes devenus lents d’oreille.
fr.B: Là-dessus, nous avons beaucoup à dire, et c’est difficile à exprimer, parce que vous êtes devenus lents à écouter.
fr.R: Nous avons beaucoup à dire à ce sujet, mais c’est difficile à vous expliquer, parce que vous êtes devenus paresseux pour écouter.

sw.L: Kuhusu jambo hilo neno letu [ni] refu na gumu kulieleza kwa maneno, kwa kuwa mmekuwa wazito katika masikio [yenu].
sw.B: Juu ya jambo hili tuna mengi ya kusema, nayo ni magumu kuyaeleza kwa maneno, kwa sababu mmekuwa wasikilizaji wazito.
sw.R: Tuna mengi ya kusema kuhusu jambo hili, lakini ni vigumu kuwaelezea, kwa sababu mmekuwa wavivu katika kusikiliza.

vi.L: Về điều này chúng tôi có lời nói dài và khó giải thích, vì anh chị em đã trở nên chậm tai.
vi.B: Về điều này chúng tôi có nhiều điều để nói, và thật khó giải thích, vì anh chị em đã trở nên chậm hiểu khi nghe.
vi.R: Chúng tôi có nhiều điều muốn nói về việc này, nhưng thật khó giải thích cho anh chị em, vì anh chị em đã trở nên lười nghe.

ko.L: 이것에 대하여 우리가 할 말이 많지만 말로 설명하기가 어렵습니다. 여러분의 귀가 둔해졌기 때문입니다.

pt.L: A respeito disso, a nossa palavra [é] longa e difícil de explicar, visto que vocês se tornaram lentos nos ouvidos.
pt.B: Sobre isso temos muito a dizer, e é difícil explicar em palavras, porque vocês se tornaram lentos para ouvir.

am.L: ስለዚህ ብዙ የምንለው ቃል አለን፤ ለመናገርም ለማብራራት አስቸጋሪ ነው፤ በጆሮአችሁ ዳተኞች ሆናችኋልና።
